paidMediaPolicyConstraints: PRP is effectively unadvertisable on Google Ads: the speculative and experimental medical treatment policy restricts cell/gene therapies and similar regenerative medicine and names platelet-rich plasma. The US exception requires the advertiser to hold the relevant FDA licence or approval for the product, which an autologous-PRP practice does not. Verified 2026-09-22; confirm with Google before treating as final.

Two of the client's ten stated keywords (PRP Hair Restoration Marlton NJ, PRP Therapy Marlton NJ) are affected, as is the priority service 'hair rejuvenation'. Paid landing pages must stay clear of PRP content to avoid disapproval.
Botox is a restricted drug term. Advertise the treatment rather than the brand; the site's existing wrinkle_relaxer_lead event already follows that pattern.
